items.say: Passengers on flight AM four-one-two to Monterrey: your flight is delayed by forty minutes.
The museum is closed today. It will open again tomorrow at ten.
Attention shoppers: all shoes are thirty percent off until Sunday.
Hi, it's Marta. The party isn't on Friday anymore. It's on Saturday at the same time.
Hello, this is the dentist's office. We need to change your appointment from Tuesday to Wednesday at four fifteen.
Hey, it's Tom. Can you buy some bread and two liters of milk on your way home?
